back: Contains –C≡N; named -nitrile, counting the CN carbon (CH₃CH₂CN = propanenitrile).

front: Making a nitrile from a halogenoalkane
back: KCN in ethanol, heat under reflux (nucleophilic substitution, +1 carbon).
Aldehyde or ketone + HCN with KCN catalyst, room temperature (nucleophilic addition).
Dilute HCl, reflux: RCN + 2H₂O + HCl → RCOOH + NH₄Cl.
NaOH(aq), reflux: RCN + NaOH + H₂O → RCOONa + NH₃; acidify to get RCOOH.
LiAlH₄ in dry ether or H₂/Ni: RCN → RCH₂NH₂ (primary amine only).

front: When to use a nitrile in synthesis
back: When the target has one more carbon than the starting material (–COOH or –CH₂NH₂ ends).
KCN and HCN are extremely toxic: gloves, fume cupboard, keep KCN away from acids.
